name: Pontiac V8 (389 / 400 / 455)
description: The Pontiac V8: 389, 400 and 455 with their factory builds (GTO 4-bbl and Tri-Power, Ram Air II, III and IV, the 455 and the 1977 Trans Am's W72) and a Tri-Power crate engine. Every part ours, drawn from solids; the Turbo Hydra-Matic from Jorma Rysky's "Naturally Aspirated 454 cid V8" (Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0).

builds.engine: Pontiac 400 H.O. Ram Air II 340 hp
Pontiac 400 Ram Air III 366 hp (GTO Judge)
Pontiac 400 W72 (1977 Trans Am 6.6, 200 hp net)
1965 Pontiac GTO 389 Tri-Power turn-key crate engine (headers)

credits: "Naturally Aspirated 454 cid V8" by Jorma Rysky (sketchfab.com/Rysky), CC BY 4.0 (the Turbo Hydra-Matic)
